capture-system-or-process-audio.kicker: Cross-Platform Audio Capture & Live PCM Mixer
highlights: Captures system speaker output, isolated per-process/application trees, and microphones without virtual audio cables.
Zero steady-state heap allocations on real-time read_into paths across Python 3.11-3.15t (-Xgil=0), Safe Rust, C++17, and C11.
Built-in CspaMixer with <10 ms drift sync, polyphase resampling, TPDF dither, and live target hot-swap.

rusty-desktop-icons.kicker: Windows Desktop Icon Controller & HLSL GPU Animator
highlights: Programmatic Windows shell desktop icon layout inspection, persistence, and manipulation from Rust and Python.
GPU-accelerated procedural HLSL shader effects, baked motion curves, and real-time animation presets.
Full Sphinx API reference and step-by-step procedural animation recipes.
